meta.title: Crucible — Infrastructure for Coding Harnesses
meta.description: Forge distributes skills, rules, and workflows across coding harnesses. Ember traces agent work as OpenTelemetry.

hero.headline: Ship shared context. Trace agent work.
hero.subheadline: Crucible builds open-source infrastructure for coding harnesses. Forge distributes skills, rules, and workflows across your tools. Ember connects agent sessions, subagents, and tool calls as OpenTelemetry traces.

problem.heading: Context and telemetry fragment across tools

scattered.title: Every harness has its own paths and formats
scattered.description: Claude Code rules, Cursor configuration, and Copilot instructions live in different places. Shared resources drift between repositories.

drift.title: Manual copies go stale
drift.description: A skill changes in one repository. Other projects keep the old version. Forge shows the drift and applies the update.

visibility.title: Agent work crosses session boundaries
visibility.description: Orchestrators, agents, subagents, and tool calls produce disconnected telemetry. Ember is building one trace tree across harnesses.

step1.title: Define resources in one source
step1.description: Keep skills, rules, and workflows in a Git repository or local directory. Use the canonical folders or your existing harness-specific layout.

step2.title: Run forge sync
step2.description: Forge resolves each enabled coding harness and writes its native paths. Dry-run shows the complete plan first.

step3.title: Keep targets in sync
step3.description: Apply transforms for Cursor and Copilot. Detect changes with SHA-256. Check drift with forge status and automate runs with the scheduler.

tools.heading: Native output for coding harnesses
tools.more: Droid and Claude Code plugin delivery is planned for Forge v0.8.

ecosystem.heading: Focused tools. Open protocols.

forge.name: Forge CLI
forge.description: Sync skills, rules, and workflows across Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, and Cline.

starter.name: Forge Skills Starter
starter.description: Develop and test agent skills, rules, and workflows in a convention-based source repository.

ember.name: Ember
ember.description: A Go OpenTelemetry Collector distribution for session trees, usage, MCP, and work attribution across coding harnesses.

ecosystem.more: More products on the {link} — Smelt, Anvil, Lathe, Foundry, Cast.
